t: You're on Great Russell Street in Bloomsbury, best known as the home of the British Museum. It runs between Tottenham Court Road in the west and Southampton Row in the east. Three people with links to the street are recorded. The painter, muralist and illustrator Mary Adshead was born here. So was George Elers, a captain in the Suffolk Regiment, whose life is preserved in his memoirs, published after his death. Norborne Thompson, an officer and later admiral of the Royal Navy, died on this street.
